verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਜਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦਾਲਦ ਦਲਘਾ ॥

transliteration.english: har har naam bhajio purakhotam sabh binase dhaaladh dhalaghaa ||

en.bdb: I chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord God, the Supreme Being, Har, Har; my poverty and problems have all been eradicated.

verse.unicode: ਭਉ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਮੇਟਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਘਾ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: bhau janam maranaa meTio gur sabadhee har asathir sev sukh samaghaa ||1||

en.bdb: The fear of birth and death has been erased, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; serving the Unmoving, Unchanging Lord, I am absorbed in peace. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਰਘਾ ॥

transliteration.english: mere man bhaj raam naam at piraghaa ||

en.bdb: O my mind, vibrate the Name of the most Beloved, Darling Lord.

verse.unicode: ਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਵੇਚਿ ਲੀਓ ਮੁਲਿ ਮਹਘਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: mai man tan arap dhario gur aagai sir vech leeo mul mahaghaa ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: I have dedicated my mind and body, and placed them in offering before the Guru; I have sold my head to the Guru, for a very dear price. ||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਕੜਿ ਖੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਕਲਘਾ ॥

transliteration.english: narapat raaje ra(n)g ras maaneh bin naavai pakaR khaRe sabh kalaghaa ||

en.bdb: The kings and the rulers of men enjoy pleasures and delights, but without the Name of the Lord, death seizes and dispatches them all.

verse.unicode: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੇ ਹਥ ਫਲਘਾ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: dharam rai sir dda(n)dd lagaanaa fir pachhutaane hath falaghaa ||2||

en.bdb: The Righteous Judge of Dharma strikes them over the heads with his staff, and when the fruits of their actions come into their hands, then they regret and repent. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਜਨ ਕਿਰਮ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਲਘਾ ॥

transliteration.english: har raakh raakh jan kiram tumaare saranaagat purakh pratipalaghaa ||

en.bdb: Save me, save me, Lord; I am Your humble servant, a mere worm. I seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary, O Primal Lord, Cherisher and Nourisher.

verse.unicode: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲੋਚ ਪੂਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਘਾ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: dharasan sa(n)t dheh sukh paavai prabh loch poor jan tumaghaa ||3||

en.bdb: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of the Saint's Darshan, that I may find peace. O God, please fulfill the desires of Your humble servant. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਘਾ ॥

transliteration.english: tum samarath purakh vadde prabh suaamee mo kau keejai dhaan har nimaghaa ||

en.bdb: You are the All-powerful, Great, Primal God, my Lord and Master. O Lord, please bless me with the gift of humility.

verse.unicode: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦ ਘੁਮਘਾ ॥੪॥੨॥

transliteration.english: jan naanak naam milai sukh paavai ham naam viTahu sadh ghumaghaa ||4||2||

en.bdb: Servant Nanak has found the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and is at peace; I am forever a sacrifice to the Naam. ||4||2||
